# Euronews

> Pan-European multilingual news media covering breaking news, politics, and current affairs across Europe, the Middle East, and global events.

Euronews delivers international news in multiple languages including Turkish, German, and Russian, with comprehensive coverage of geopolitical conflicts, EU politics, NATO affairs, and regional developments in Turkey, Iran, Israel, and the Middle East. The platform provides video-on-demand news content and real-time updates on global events.

## Key Topics

- Middle East conflicts (Orta Doğu)
- Ukraine (Ukrayna)
- Iran-Israel tensions (İran-İsrail çatışması)
- Turkey news (Türkiye haberleri)
- Strait of Hormuz (Hürmüz Boğazı)
- NATO developments
- Breaking news (Son dakika)
- Iran war coverage (İran savaşı)
- Gulf region (Körfez)
- United States (ABD)
- Netanyahu and Israeli politics
- Turkish Ministry of Defense (MSB)
- Aviation news (Havacılık)
- Social media trends (Sosyal medya)
- Turkish tourism (Türkiye turizm)

## Regional News Portals

- [Turkish Homepage](https://tr.euronews.com/): Turkish-language homepage featuring breaking news on Ukraine, Iran, Middle East conflicts, and global events with video-on-demand content
- [German Homepage](http://de.euronews.com/): German-language homepage with video news coverage on Ukraine, Iran, Trump, EU politics, and international affairs

## Breaking News & Live Coverage

- [Latest News Timeline](https://tr.euronews.com/son-haberler): Live timeline feed of latest international breaking news covering Middle East conflicts, European developments, and global events in real-time
- [Qatar-Iran Missile Crisis](https://ru.euronews.com/2026/02/28/qatar-threatens-retaliation-after-intercepting-third-wave-of-iranian-missiles-over-doha): Russian-language coverage of Qatar's response to Iranian missile strikes over Doha and threats of retaliation amid Gulf tensions

## Optional

- [Messaging Apps Access](https://www.euronews.com/messaging-apps): Instructions for accessing Euronews content through Telegram and Viber messaging platforms
